jobs.title: Video Editor Working Student
jobs.description: In a nutshell We’re looking for a technically skilled and creatively driven Video Editor Working Student. Your primary focus will be the post-production of our employer branding organic social content, acting as the final touch that ensures every video is engaging through dynamic editing and recognizable as Picnic at a glance. You’ll collaborate with a diverse team of campaign and event managers, supported by designers and the wider recruitment team of 30+ colleagues. Together, you’ll create high-impact work that doesn’t just sit in a folder. Our campaigns are the heart of our employer brand; convincing quality talent to join the ride. Tricks of the trade Video Editing: Take raw footage and turn it into engaging content for LinkedIn and Instagram. Set Prep & Shooting : Support the team during shoots and directing non-professional subjects. Motion Graphics: A plus if you know the basics of motion graphics. Color Grading & Branding: Use your eye for detail to ensure all video assets are aligned, of high quality, and follow the branding guidelines. Your superpowers You are currently pursuing a study in a creative field (e.g. Media studies or similar). You are a strong short-form editor: hooks, retention editing, colour grading, sound design, and a sense of music and tempo. You are comfortable shooting content with both a smartphone and a camera, with a good eye for framing, lighting, and composition.  You understand color theory and have experience with editing and color grading software (Adobe Suite and CapCut). You think in "systems" and understand how to build project files that can be easily adapted to different platforms. Bonus: you have working knowledge of After Effects to adjust animations and graphics, as well as photography skills. Fluent in English (Dutch, French or German are a plus!) L équipe Content est au cœur de la stratégie d expérience globale de Decathlon. Notre mission est de propulser et de diffuser l ensemble des contenus de l écosystème : de la gestion des médias à l internationalisation des traductions, en passant par la valorisation des avis utilisateurs. Nous gérons des plateformes à très haute échelle, connectées mondialement, avec pour ambition de transformer la manière dont nos utilisateurs consomment et interagissent avec l information produit. Un terrain de jeu technologique et fonctionnel passionnant, multiculturel et à fort impact ! TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION En tant qu Engineering Manager, tu seras le pilier humain et technique d une équipe de 13 ingénieur·es (développeur·ses, QA, support), composée de profils internes et de partenaires externes. Management & Accompagnement : Tu animes, coaches et fais grandir une équipe pluridisciplinaire. Stratégie Produit & Déploiement : Tu pilotes le déploiement à l échelle de onecontent comme produit de diffusion unique des contenus de Decathlon, avant de mener la redéfinition globale de notre stratégie de plateforme. Innovation & IA : Tu orchestres la construction et le déploiement de Onetranslate , notre moteur de traduction de pointe piloté par l Intelligence Artificielle. Expérience Utilisateur : Tu supervises le déploiement du nouveau moteur de modération des avis clients, incluant la gestion et la valorisation des avis photos. jobs.title: Content Reviewer - United States
jobs.description: We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit. A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform. By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself. Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies. Service Rates The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Qualification path Qualification Process No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process
